title: US-China Trade Deal: Reshaping Grain and Coal Trade Flows
section_path: US-China Trade Deal: Reshaping Grain and Coal Trade Flows

Main
Image reference: assets/2026-10-08_us-china-trade-deal-reshaping-grain-and-coal-trade-flows_img_rgb-color-brs-shipbrokers-monogram-l_c365f35f1de5.png
On 28 September, the US and China announced a new trade agreement following the summit between Presidents Trump and Xi. The two countries agreed to provide more favourable tariffs for approximately $30 billion of each other's non-sensitive goods imports. Tariffs on around 90% of covered products are expected to be reduced to most-favored-nation rates, subject to each side completing its domestic procedures.
